Why this result?

Pause before you act

  1. Keep your OTP, PIN, and passwords private.
  2. End the call if the request seems suspicious.
  3. Open your bank app independently, or use the number printed on your card. Verify the specific request.

A caller knowing your details does not prove the request is genuine.

How signals combine

High-risk request → high-risk warning. Two caution categories, or a caution category plus a pressure/trust cue, also trigger a high-risk warning. Repeated mentions of the same rule count once. Context cues alone prompt a review.

A local report is unverified. A sample flagged-number match triggers a demo warning. No result certifies a caller or establishes criminal intent. Speech and phrases outside the selected patterns can be missed.

BUILT FOR YOUR VIVA

CallGuard, explained.

A call-focused banking scam detection prototype.

The problem

A caller can know a customer’s details—even be a real employee—and still make an unsafe request. CallGuard evaluates what the caller asks the customer to do.

The pipeline

Text / microphone↓Speaker & clause parsing↓Rules + recent context + local number check↓Evidence + recommended action

What works in this version

  • Editable transcripts and text-file import
  • Incremental simulation of 20 call scenarios
  • Selected English, Hinglish, and Hindi detection
  • Context, negation, speaker, and combination handling
  • Local number reports and sample reputation matches
  • Optional browser microphone speech recognition
  • Downloadable report with raw transcript excluded

No custom ML training

The detector uses explicit rules. Optional speech-to-text uses your browser’s pretrained recognition service.

Limits to state clearly

  • No guarantee of detecting every scam, euphemism, or language.
  • No proof of caller identity, employee status, or intent.
  • No live reputation feed, bank API, or telecom integration.
  • No interception, automatic hang-up, or transaction blocking.
  • Audio recordings cannot be uploaded for transcription in this version.
  • Microphone support and accuracy depend on the browser. Text input always works.
  • Local reports are not independently verified.

Data & privacy

Transcripts are processed in this tab and are not saved by the app. Only numbers you explicitly report and the sample-data preference are saved in this browser. Remove a local report in the watchlist to erase it.

Microphone mode requires an explicit start and may send speech to your browser vendor’s service. No raw audio is recorded by CallGuard.

Exported evidence is automatically redacted on a best-effort basis. Review it before sharing.

If fraud has occurred

Contact your bank immediately through an independently verified channel. In India, use the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or call 1930. Report suspicious communications through Chakshu.

Reference material

Fraud guidance informs the rules; the thresholds and implementation are project design choices. Reviewed 15 September 2026.
